title: Doors of Quartz County
body:
I filmed all 33 architectural door designs in Quartz County. The gallery puts fitted entrances and reserve assemblies side by side, with the same latches, tracks, motors and sounds you hear when you use them in the game.

At Canal Townhouse, the thumb latch releases before the carved leaf swings. Orchard Cottage and Alpine Lodge use iron fittings, while the Scrappy Rowhouse has painted panels and the Craftsman porch door has divided glass. Cream Corner Apartments gets glazed lobby doors and an intercom. Gable Duplex and Lantern Flats share the steel walk-up door.

Quartz Mart, Corner Café, Depot Corner Shop and Mirror Lake Café use the same framed glass door. The archive has paneled oak pairs, Quartz Hotel has bronze trim, Orbit Clinic has striped sliding glass, and Mergeforge Office has glazed double leaves.

The farmhouse Dutch door has two leaves that move separately. Red Barn has wide sliders below and a pair of hinged hayloft doors above. The repair workshop doors turn overhead, the Parcel Hub bays have rubber dock shelters, the harbor warehouse doors slide sideways, and the Mart’s receiving door rolls onto a drum.

The film ends in the walkable Entrance Controls Lab. A wall button releases the cold-store slider. At the dock, the overhead door clears before the deck lifts and the lip folds out. On coupled doors such as the hayloft, the shared latch stays clear until both leaves close. AgY modeled the doors, Game Asset Prep baked the surface detail, and the game’s sound cues came from four Omni Flow recordings.

images.alt: The Alpine Lodge door is partly open, showing its dark iron strap hinges and barred window.
The upper leaf of the teal farmhouse Dutch door swings ahead of the lower leaf.
The Quartz Hotel double doors have dark bronze trim and geometric glazing beneath the hotel sign.
The striped glass leaves at Orbit Clinic slide apart beneath the green canopy.
The braced Red Barn doors slide apart along the black track above the opening.
The cream overhead door begins to lift above the loading dock deck and yellow safety posts.

videos.caption: Every architectural door design in the game, followed by the walkable Entrance Controls Lab.
